sources.title: FINAL-Bench/Darwin-180B-RSI · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Earlier Darwin generations grafted the best-performing expert/FFN blocks from other strong models onto a base backbone; Darwin-180B-RSI adds a new ingredient — the model's own verified work.

sources.title: Darwin-180B-RSI by FINAL_Bench: Open-Weight Model
sources.snippet: Darwin-180B-RSI is an open-weight model for image and text to text from FINAL_Bench, released under other. It has 180B parameters and a 262,144-token context. At 16-bit it needs about 432 GB of GPU memory, which fits on 2x MI325X from $7.60 an hour; at 4-bit, 108 GB on 1x MI300X from $2.59, at the lowest prices in the SAVRN Index.
